prior_transport_failure: native pipe unavailable (os error 2); resolved in current session
role_count_limitation: word counts in formatted tree, not authoritative UIA control counts
login_marker_limitation: text marker detected; account authentication state not independently verified
capture_boundary: accessibility text processed transiently in JS; only counts and boolean markers emitted, no raw tree or account data saved by task
next: user completes login; then one read-only chat-window capability observation
